texts: On day 230 of Year 1, Coraline Ash began a solo stretch of thirty nights at the Harbor Station.
Pell did not accompany Coraline Ash during the solo stretch.
Pell visited the Harbor Station on her own off-nights.
During the solo stretch, Coraline Ash lit the lantern at sundown every night.
During the solo stretch, Coraline Ash refreshed the mire-essence at midnight every night.
During the solo stretch, Coraline Ash trimmed the wick at the third watch every night.
During the solo stretch, Coraline Ash extinguished the lantern at dawn every night.
Coraline Ash kept the notebook carefully.

q1_issues.issue: "her own" is silently dropped -- no Possession links the off-nights to Pell, so the parse widens the claim to off-nights in general.
The plural "off-nights" (several occasions) collapses into a single Past visit event with no recurrence atom and no group witness for the possessed plural.
"every night" is encoded as a period (Every e 1 night), but "night" is a day-part like "morning", which the slot rule maps to (Time e night) + (Every e 1 day); same at 36, 44, 51.

q2_gaps: inceptive verb with an event-denoting NOUN object ("began a solo stretch of thirty nights") -- Inception covers only "to V" / "V-ing" complements, so nothing says whether the noun-eventuality takes Ongoing, its own tense, or a role linking the subject to it

past-tense habitual: a finite past clause carrying "every night" -- Frequency & habitual schedules says the event stays unmarked, Status predicates tenses finite clauses, and no rule says which wins for a habitual bounded inside a past interval (the parse emits both Past and Every)

a possessed plural common-noun NP as a temporal adjunct ("on her own off-nights") -- Time takes structured terms, deictics or bare day-part constants, with no slot for a witness/group that carries a possessor
review.notes: Roles, the negation bundle, During, compound decomposition (mire_essence, off_night) and cross-sentence coreference (the stretch, the lantern) are all handled correctly. The defects are confined to the "her own off-nights" adjunct and the frequency encoding.

issues.reason: Core patterns forbids silently dropping a stated restriction ("omitting it widens the claim -- carry it, or leave the whole claim out") and Possessive / genitive NP mandates (Possession <possessed> <possessor>) for a possessive pronoun, so "her own" could not simply vanish into the bare constant off_night.

The missing group witness for the possessed plural is real (it is issue 0's defect), but the demand for a recurrence atom falls: Quantifiers states Every / TimesPer "need a stated period or rate" and that an unrepresentable frequency adverbial is left out rather than mis-slotted, and no rule pluralizes events off a plural temporal adjunct.

Frequency & habitual schedules puts a NAMED SLOT on Time and adds its cycle -- "every morning" -> (Time e morning) + (Every e 1 day) -- and night is one of the instruction set's own day-part constants ("at night", "overnight-as-night"), so (Every e 1 night) mis-files the slot as a period in a unit the time lexicon does not define.

gaps_confirmed: inceptive verb with an event-denoting NOUN complement ("began a solo stretch of thirty nights") -- Inception covers only "to V" / "V-ing", leaving the noun-eventuality's aspect, tense and linking role undetermined
past-tense habitual -- Frequency says a habitual event stays unmarked while Status predicates tenses every finite clause, and nothing resolves which wins for a habit bounded inside a past interval

a possessed plural common-noun NP as a temporal adjunct ("on her own off-nights") -- the Time role's filler grammar is structured terms, deictic/named constants and day-part symbols, with no slot for a witness or group carrying a possessor
new_gaps: a named-slot recurrence that contradicts the clause's own stated time point ("extinguished the lantern at dawn every night"): the slot rule would add (Time e night) beside (Time e dawn), which is false of that event, and nothing licenses keeping only the (Every e 1 day) cycle while suppressing the conflicting slot

plurality of occasions has no carrier: a plural temporal adjunct ("on her off-nights") states several visits, but Every / TimesPer require a stated period or rate and no other head records repeated occurrence, so a single event witness under-reports and there is no licensed alternative

an ordinal-day fictional calendar ("on day 230 of Year 1"): the (Day <n>) term is a day-of-month slot and (Year <n>) a calendar year, so a day-of-year 230 in "Year 1" has no defined reading -- the atom records the surface but no rule says how such a calendar is termed
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: the compliant form carries the possessor -- the possessed plural as a group witness, (GroupOf sk_offnight_1 off_night) + (Possession sk_offnight_1 pell), filling the visit's temporal slot -- but the Time role licenses no filler of that shape, so the carrier itself is filed as a gap and the alternative the instruction set actually licenses is to leave the adjunct out and record the loss. Issue 1 (partial half that stands): the same possessed-plural group witness is the compliant form; no recurrence atom is licensed at all. Issue 2: the compliant form on each of the four nightly events is the named-slot pair (Time e night) + (Every e 1 day) in place of (Every e 1 night), with the caveat that for the dawn event the slot half conflicts with the stated time point (new gap).
adjudication.notes: Roles, the strength-0 accompany bundle, the During links, the compound decompositions (mire_essence, off_night) and cross-sentence coreference are all sound; the confirmed defects are confined to the "her own off-nights" adjunct and the four Every atoms. One thing the reviewer did not file: Inception says the activity witness is "Past if past", and sk_stretch_1 carries Ongoing with no Past.
